name: Lab monitor - eye tracker, 24-2 within 15 deg (51 cm)
description: Eye tracker (Tobii Pro Fusion, 50-80 cm): the 24-2 positions within +/-15 deg on all sides (3, 9, 15 deg; 6 deg apart), 34 spots tested, at 51 cm with a chin rest (fits up to 52.8 cm on the BenQ). Full Threshold 4-2 staircase (OPI). Start python/specvis.sh tracker-bridge first. Screen: BenQ 24.5", 544 x 303 mm. Choose the ColorCAL scale "Lab screen". The app calibrates the tracker, checks accuracy and the eye distance (+/-1 cm) at the start.
